M1: Normal member H3 median split; report E_multistage and E_xstage low-H minus high-H win; primary PASS lower CI >0 and >=8 positive classes
M2: exact target 518x518 occupancy in 14x14 blocks; risky positive patches contain any S_rank20 pixel and occupancy>0; valid 8-neighbor surroundedness; rho=Spearman(max(A5,A7)-A3,surroundedness); PASS lower CI >0 and >=8 positive classes

feature_semantics.alignment: authoritative 37x37 grid; bilinear align_corners=True only if a stage grid differs, followed by L2 renormalization

gates.A: bootstrap lower CI matched win >0.5 and >=8 supportive classes
gates.B: positive C_AP and R_pos capture exceed fixed confidence and D_rank controls
gates.C: aligned win and positive C_AP capture exceed shifted control
gates.D: Normal fraction and negative R_neg capture do not exceed both controls

local_formula.H_g_s: mean pairwise(1-cosine(ring_i,ring_j)); normalized ring-sum identity, no pair matrix

local_scales.padding: none; valid positions only; no circular or replicated feature padding

matching: reuse B0 deterministic_matches: same-class score x D_rank 10x10 quantile bins, deterministic SHA256 keyed control, no candidate evidence

nonlocal_fallback.abstain: fewer than K valid peers -> valid_reference=false and evidence=0
nonlocal_fallback.descriptor: normalize(mean over three aligned stage features)
nonlocal_fallback.evidence: mean_g 1-cosine(center stage, normalized mean of same selected peers)
nonlocal_fallback.pool: same image; Chebyshev distance >3; D_rank below image median; all stage anomaly percentiles <0.5
nonlocal_fallback.tie: descending cosine then ascending patch index

old_baseline: E_multistage imported from audit_phase5_second_evidence.evidence_maps; B0 parity required <=1e-6 on the real dry-run image
population: S_rank20 = top ceil(0.20*N_class) D_rank pixels per class; GT-free stable identity ordering
spatial_control: reuse B0 shifted_map: wraparound floor(518/3)=172 pixels in both axes
triage: inside S_rank20 select top ceil(0.10*|S_rank20|); U_conf=-abs(final_margin) and D_rank controls use exact same K
